n: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit
t: NVIDIA's top AI computer for humanoid robots and very large local models.
steps: Buy the kit from the NVIDIA Marketplace, Newegg or Waveshare. NVIDIA lists it at 5,499 US dollars after a July 2026 price rise.
Connect an HDMI or DisplayPort screen, a keyboard and a mouse.
Plug the included power supply into one of the regular USB-C ports.
Turn it on and finish the Ubuntu setup screens.
Follow the NVIDIA quick start to update JetPack with the Jetson ISO on a USB stick.
Install the jetson-containers tools from GitHub.
Start a container and chat with a local language model as your first test.
meta: Open Board. From $3,499. A few stores.
